title: AZ-900 · Describe Azure storage services · Describe Azure storage accounts

questions.category: Describe Azure Architecture and Services > Describe Azure storage services
questions.description: Microsoft Learn unit: Describe Azure storage accounts
questions.question: Which statement best describes Azure storage account?

options.text: A resource that provides a unique namespace for Azure Storage data and exposes storage services through endpoints
A hub for assessing and migrating on-premises infrastructure, servers, databases, and applications to Azure
Storage Explorer running on Windows, macOS, and Linux
Azure Storage keeping three copies of data in the primary region

questions.explanation: Azure storage account is a resource that provides a unique namespace for Azure Storage data and exposes storage services through endpoints.

questions.category: Describe Azure Architecture and Services > Describe Azure storage services
questions.description: Microsoft Learn unit: Describe Azure storage accounts
questions.question: In the context of this Microsoft Learn unit, what does Standard general-purpose v2 refer to?

options.text: The lowest-cost storage tier for rarely accessed data with the highest retrieval latency and a long intended retention period
The recommended standard account type for most blob, file, queue, and table storage scenarios
Using Azure File Sync to retain fast local access while centralizing file shares in Azure Files
Managed cloud file shares accessible with protocols such as SMB or NFS

questions.explanation: Standard general-purpose v2 is the recommended standard account type for most blob, file, queue, and table storage scenarios.

questions.category: Describe Azure Architecture and Services > Describe Azure storage services

options.text: A cross-platform graphical application for managing Azure Storage files and blobs

questions.description: Microsoft Learn unit: Describe Azure storage accounts
questions.question: Select the TWO statements that are correct according to this unit.

options.text: Premium block blobs: synchronous replication across three availability zones in the primary region.
Azure storage account: a premium account type for Azure Files that supports SMB and NFS shares.
Standard general-purpose v2: a name of 3–24 characters using lowercase letters and numbers only.
Standard general-purpose v2: the recommended standard account type for most blob, file, queue, and table storage scenarios.
Azure storage account: a resource that provides a unique namespace for Azure Storage data and exposes storage services through endpoints.

questions.explanation: The correct pair is: Azure storage account — a resource that provides a unique namespace for Azure Storage data and exposes storage services through endpoints; and Standard general-purpose v2 — the recommended standard account type for most blob, file, queue, and table storage scenarios.
